## Description

APNs and FCM through Azure Notification Hubs in the tenant's country. Payloads carry an opaque ID and the fixed text 'You have an update from your clinic'; the app fetches the detail after unlock. Per-user opt-in and quiet hours; failures visible in the staff notification centre (MDV-P1-034).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given a result is ready, when a push is sent, then the payload holds an ID and the fixed text and no test, doctor speciality or result.
- [ ] **AC2.** Given the user turns notifications off, when an event happens, then no push is sent and the in-app list still shows it.
- [ ] **AC3.** Given a push token is revoked, when an event happens, then no push goes to that device.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
